mapper.select: SELECT id, name, type, description, status, location, contact_info, capacity, unit, organization_id, create_time, update_time, creator, updater, deleted FROM resource_pool WHERE type = #{type} AND status = 'available' AND deleted = false ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT id, name, type, description, status, location, contact_info, capacity, unit, organization_id, create_time, update_time, creator, updater, deleted FROM resource_pool WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND deleted = false ORDER BY create_time DESC
